title: Run a common event on game boot (before the title screen)

posts.author: I_LIKE_BREAD7
posts.body:
ILB_OnBootCommonEvent
v1.0.0
I_LIKE_BREAD7
Introduction
This plugin allows you to call a common event at the start of the game (before the title screen).
It can be used for multiple different purposes, I use it to create a language choice menu before the game starts.
Features
Allows you to run a common event before the title screen with messages, a choice menu etc.
Screenshots
How to Use
Just add it through the plugin manager and set the Common Event ID parameter.
